title: Wiemer hero
description: A full-bleed interior photo one and a half windows tall (one window on phones) with a soft dark wash at the top. A huge centred light wordmark-style title and a two-line subline fill the first screen; a hairline, a short launch line on the left and a teaser card on the right sit at the bottom. The photo drifts down as you scroll (parallax) and the copy fades away as it leaves.
notes: the light text needs a dark photo; the empty placeholder is a dark gradient for that reason
the big title shows from md up; phones see the photo with the launch line and the card
